usedFor: PDFGate reports envelope events, and viaSocket utilities starts another workflow when “Envelope Document Completed” runs “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “Envelope Document Completed” in PDFGate, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A completed envelope document can start a second workflow, such as filing or notifying, with no manual step.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” runs another viaSocket workflow, so check that the second workflow exists and is switched on.
